observations.body: The psalm asks God to give the king justice, defend the poor, crush oppression, extend peace, receive tribute, and bless all nations.

observations.body: The needy, poor, oppressed, kings, nations, and the whole earth appear within the royal horizon.

payload.posture: Read Psalms 72:1–20 as reputation, wealth, and royal ideals evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The superscription links the psalm to Solomon, but its prayer exceeds a simple report of one reign.
